Confidence grows with the number of reviews: a single 5-star review weighs little, five consistent reviews weigh fully (see “Neutral reviews added”).
Bonus des titres hors bibliothèque que T: Bonus for titles outside the library that TMDb recommends from several liked titles, only if they already match the tastes (safeguard).
Bonus des titres que TMDb recommande à p: Bonus for titles TMDb recommends from several liked titles — outside the library (extended mode) as well as in the library (General tab, Sources) — only if they already fit the tastes (safeguard).
Bonus des titres regardés par beaucoup d: Bonus for titles watched by many accounts on the server, and for those trending on TMDb (see “TMDb trend in popularity”, “Reserved bonuses and safeguard” box), only if they already match the taste (safeguard).
Bonus for titles watched by many accounts on the server, only if they already match the tastes (safeguard).
Bonus des titres récemment ajoutés, uniq: Bonus for recently added titles, only if they already match the account's tastes (safeguard). Capped: ×2 at most.
Bonus des titres sortis récemment (date: Bonus for recently released titles (release date, not library addition), only if they already match the tastes. Off by default: not evaluated on real history — Calibration may suggest it.
Bonus réservés aux N premiers: Bonuses reserved for the top N
Bonus réservés aux N premiers par goût: Bonuses reserved for the top N per taste
Bonus réservés aux titres qui collent dé: Bonuses reserved for titles that already match the tastes (safeguard)
Bruit ajouté chaque jour au classement d: Noise added each day to the ranking of titles outside the library: 0 = always the same order, 0.3 = titles of similar value swap places, 1 = lots of movement. A clearly worse title never overtakes a very good one. Fixed for the day.

Ce qu'un titre trouvé doit avoir pour êt: What a title found must have to be suggested, whatever its source (hidden gems and “top rated” also have their own minimums, under their source).
Ce que Reco+ écrit dans le journal de Je: What Reco+ writes to the Jellyfin log, live (Information level and above, set by Jellyfin). Values that look like secrets (key, token, password) are masked. Refreshed every 2 seconds while the tab is open.
Ce que les comptes font des titres de la: What accounts do with the library titles offered in their rows: started within 7 days of the first time they were offered, watched in full within 30 days. A title offered more recently is not counted yet. Nothing is asked of the accounts: the watch history is enough.
Ce que vous réglez ici ne vaut que pour: What you set here applies to your account only.
Ce qui est lu en plus de l'historique: What is read besides the history
Ce qui est montré, sans changer le calcu: What is shown, without changing how tastes are computed: these settings apply after ranking (they take part neither in evaluation nor in calibration). They apply to {ROW}, Suggestions and extended mode; “More like this” is only filtered by ignored accounts.
Ce qui fait parler en ce moment sur TMDb: What people are talking about right now on TMDb (trending this week or today), ordered by the account's taste (setting below). Requires Seerr.
Ce réglage n'est PAS recommandé (gain ab: These settings are NOT recommended (no gain, uncertain or negligible). Apply them anyway? (the current ones are kept so you can go back)
Ces comptes n'ont pas de recommandations: These accounts get no Reco+ recommendations (Jellyfin answers them normally) and their history doesn't count for the household: guest, test or child account…
Ces deux méthodes refont tout leur appre: These two methods redo all their learning for each group: it's the longest part of calibration. 0 = automatic: the square root of twice the groups above, rounded (2 → 2, 5 → 3, 10 → 4), never more than them.
Chacun peut couper les titres hors bibli: Everyone can turn off titles outside the library
Chaque facteur s'active ou se coupe, et: Each factor can be switched on or off, and strengthened or weakened (×1 = evaluated value, ×0.25 to ×3). Hover over ? to see what it does.
Chaque interrupteur coupé rend la main à: Each switch turned off hands that part back to Jellyfin.
Chaque jour, un nouveau tirage parmi les: Every day, a new draw among the titles read: the best placed (TMDb and taste) come out most often, those at the bottom now and then; the same list all day. 0 = fixed order; 1 = the most change. Default 0.6.
Chaque méthode donne un chemin qui s'élo: Each method gives a path moving away from the current settings, measured step by step with cross-validation. Cautious: the shortest step that does almost as well as the best one (within one standard error) — without clear evidence, it moves less. The best step sometimes gains a little more, but more often follows the randomness of the history.
Chaque méthode est refaite sans un group: Each method is redone without one group of accounts and measured on that group, for each group. More groups = less noisy measurement (each training sees more accounts) but longer computation. 0 = automatic: the square root of the number of accounts, rounded (as many groups as accounts per group: 4 accounts → 2, 9 → 3, 16 → 4, 25 → 5), between 2 and 10, never more than the number of accounts.
Code de pays inconnu : {0} (deux lettres: Unknown country code: {0} (two ISO letters, e.g. US, GB, CA, FR).

Comptes calculés en même temps, et cas é: Accounts computed at the same time, and cases evaluated at the same time during calibration. 0 = automatic: half of the cores, so Jellyfin keeps enough to serve playback. More = faster, but more CPU used during computation.
Coupé : Jellyfin se comporte exactement: Off: Jellyfin behaves exactly as without the plugin, everywhere.
Dans le haut de liste. S'il en manque, l: In the top of the list. If some are missing, the best-ranked movies move up in place of the lowest-ranked series. 0 = no minimum.
In the top of the list. If some are missing, the best-ranked series move up in place of the lowest-ranked movies. 0 = no minimum. If movies + series exceed the top of the list, shared proportionally.
Dans sa page, un utilisateur peut fixer: On their page, a user can set their country instead of having it detected.
Dans sa page, un utilisateur peut ne rec: On their page, a user can receive library titles only (extended mode off for them alone).
De 0 (ordre des goûts) à 1 (seule la rép: From 0 (order of tastes) to 1 (only the genre distribution counts). Calibrated diversity only.
Demandes comme signal de goût, titres de: Requests as a taste signal, requested titles that arrived first, extended mode.

Effacer l'URL et le jeton enregistrés ?: Clear the saved URL and token?

En tête de liste: At the top of the list
Saved: your lists are being recomputed.

Exponentielle : l'ancien s'efface franch: Exponential: old titles fade away clearly. Power: old titles fade slowly and keep a tail (Larrain, Parra et al. 2015).
Facultatif. Sans Seerr (ou s'il est injo: Optional. Without Seerr (or if it can't be reached), everything else works. The key is stored separately (file with 600 permissions) and is never returned by the API.
Fait remonter ce qui ressemble aux titre: Pushes up what resembles liked titles watched in the same time slot as now (night 0-6, morning, afternoon, evening 18-24): you don't watch the same things at 8 am and 11 pm. A list is then computed per slot and served according to the time. Off by default: on the reference history it does worse (too few views per slot and per account) — Calibration may suggest it on yours. Time zone: General tab, “Operation” box.
Fait remonter les titres souvent regardé: Pushes up titles often watched by the same people as the account's liked titles (collaborative filtering, cautious on a small household).
Fait remonter un peu les titres dont la: Lifts titles whose language or country is familiar to the account a little: what it already likes to watch, and at first the language of its country (General tab, accounts' country). Fiches demandées à Seerr pour départager: Details requested from Seerr to decide between candidates (cached 14 days). More = better choice, more calls. Preselection: titles suggested by the most liked titles first. Only detailed titles can be ranked: it's the setting that matters most. Sources share this number in balanced parts. First computation longer, then cached.

The first N of the TMDb list, for movies and for series.

Les films suivants du classement du comp: The next movies in the account's ranking, without those of the rows above.
Les mieux notés de ses genres préférés: Top rated in their favorite genres
Les nouveautés de ce que le compte suit: What the account follows goes first for a while: new episodes or a new season of a series it caught up on, the next part of a saga. A title it requested never does: it already knows it wants it; it is ranked like the others, held back at first, and may come back if still unwatched.

Les séries suivantes du classement du co: The next series in the account's ranking, without those of the rows above.

Les titres les plus votés sur TMDb, tout: The most voted titles on TMDb, all eras together: safe bets the account has not watched yet, drawn again every day. Trending follows the moment. Requires Seerr.
Les titres suivants du classement du com: The next titles of the account's ranking, without those of the rows above. Split into two rows by default, movies and series; merged, a single row of movies and series.
Listes du moment (tendances, plus popula: Current lists (trending, most popular, new releases, upcoming)

Lit la liste de suivi Seerr de chaque co: Reads the Seerr watchlist of each linked account (one request per account on full computation).
Lit le nombre de votes derrière chaque n: Reads the number of votes behind each rating, so as not to trust a rating based on a handful of votes. Missing details are fetched gradually (150 per full computation, cached 14 days).

Modèle de choix appris : apprend d'un co: Learned choice model: learns the 10 score weights at once (“which title was chosen among all those that could be suggested”), staying close to the current settings without evidence; few parameters, so reliable with little history; about one minute. Slider search: tunes more than 30 settings one by one, content and signals included; needs much more history; up to an hour. Neural network (experimental): small non-linear correction (96 parameters) added to the score, pulled back to zero without evidence; needs a lot of history; a few minutes. Automatic: all of them, keeping the one that generalizes best; long and CPU-hungry (up to an hour). Default: learned choice model.
Modèle de choix et réseau : à l'intérieu: Choice model and network: within each group, the regularization strength is chosen by a nested cross-validation over this many groups. 0 = automatic: 2.

Each method is redone without one group of accounts and measured on that group, for each group (cross-validation; by default, the square root of the number of accounts as groups), at each step of its path towards the learned settings; the most cautious step that does almost as well as the best one is kept. Settings are only recommended if their gain holds, reliably and by at least the minimum gain (1% by default), for accounts that weren't used to choose them (below that, nothing would be visible). Nothing is applied without your click; the Lists and General tabs are not involved. Also visible in Scheduled Tasks.

Un titre commencé n'est « abandonné » qu: A started title is only “abandoned” after this period without resuming: before that, it's simply in progress.

A title outside the library must rank, for this account, at least as well as this share of its library: 0 = no minimum, 0.5 = better than half of its titles, 1 = better than all. Higher = fewer titles, closer to its taste.

Un titre resté plusieurs jours à l'écran: A title that stayed on the account's screen for several days without being opened is a discreet “no”: it loses part of its score (at most 40% at ×1, reached gradually), and gets it back over time. The account therefore sees something else instead of the same ignored cards. Opening it resets the counter. Requires “Titles shown without being opened” (General tab). Not measurable by calibration (no display history).
Un titre très ancien ne descend jamais s: A very old title never goes below this share of its weight (0-1).
Un titre vu jusqu'au bout il y a très lo: A title watched to the end a very long time ago can come back in the list rows (never an abandoned or hidden title; Home Screen Sections also has its own “Watch again” row).
Une collection plus grande que ce nombre: A collection larger than this number is not a saga but a grouping (“Marvel movies”, “Ghibli”): 2 entries at most, without the first-part rule.
Une demande jamais regardée ne compte pl: A request never watched no longer counts at all after this delay.
Une demande perd la moitié de son poids: A request loses half its weight after this delay.
Une langue d'origine n'est explorée que: An original language is only explored if it weighs at least this share of liked titles (e.g. Japanese for lots of anime).
Une saison mise en favori (sans la série: A favorite season (without the series) counts as this share of a favorite: you can like a season without liking the whole series.
Une seule entrée par saga, et c'est le p: Only one entry per saga, and it's the first part not yet watched (not the 4th when you haven't seen the 1st).
Une sortie avec moins de votes n'est pas: A release with fewer votes is not shown, even in the library (below that, the rating means nothing). 0 = no minimum. A title released less than a month ago needs proportionally fewer (votes build up over time).

A release with fewer votes is not shown, even in the library: 100 votes is the most-voted quarter of films released one to two months ago. A title released less than a month ago needs proportionally fewer (votes build up over time); a series only needs a quarter (TMDb counts about four times fewer votes for series). 0 = no minimum.
Une sortie moins bien notée n'est pas mo: A lower-rated release is not shown, even in the library: leaves out poor-quality productions. 0 = no minimum. Reliable rating: with few votes it is pulled toward the average of recent releases rather than taken at face value.
Utilisé seulement sans Jellyfin Enhanced: Only used without Jellyfin Enhanced. The request is made on behalf of the user, with their Seerr permissions and quotas.
Valeurs par défaut = réglage retenu aprè: Default values = settings kept after evaluation. The safeguard (freshness, popularity and rating bonuses reserved for titles that already match the account's tastes) is always active; freshness is capped at 4. To tune on your data, prefer the Calibration tab.
Validation croisée, prudence, recherche: Cross-validation, caution, search (0 = automatic); saved right away.
Vide = détection automatique. Sert à dat: Empty = automatic detection. Used to date precisely the first playback of each title, useful for calibration.
Vide = détecté pour chaque compte, sans: Empty = detected for each account, without sending anything outside: time zone and languages of its browser, its Jellyfin interface language, its preferred subtitle and audio languages, then the server's settings. One code (e.g. US) or several (US, GB, CA): these countries for all accounts, except those that choose their own. *: international (worldwide release dates, no country favored). Used for new-release dates and the titles' origin preference; no effect on parental control (ratings country, Seerr tab).
